matching_stratum: target_year x municipality x dominant_SKO x global_current_area_decile
eligibility_interpretation: scenario diagnostic from observed 2015-2025 history; not frozen agronomic rule
guardrails: 2015-2025 history is left-censored: no observed pea is not the same as never pea
mixed/complex CONSERVART components are reported as a separate stricter sensitivity basis
OTHER_PEA and FABA_BEAN are separate scenario flags, not assumed biologically equivalent to CONSERVART
predecessor enrichment is historical selection association, not causal yield response
